lena: Quick heads-up  opened a small docs PR that adds a compact prefetch cost FAQ + two tiny SDK samples (Node + Python). Trying to keep it to a single card for the console quick-help. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310 :sparkles:

 tom: skimmed. two notes: 1) the console cost dashboard currently expects metric `kv_prefetch_hit_total` while the runtime emits `kv_prefetch_hits` in some regions 11 we should call out that alias mapping. 2) link by dashboard ID so names don't drift: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-220-prefetch-cost

 izzy: also add a one-liner about TTLs (short TTL = more misses = higher token spend) and a note on sampling: span sampling < 1 will make request-level cost charts look sparse.

 lena: added TTL + sampling lines. pasted the two micro-snippets below (5 lines each) so they fit in the quick reference card. feedback welcome.

 lena: ```js
 // Node prefetch example: attach tracekey and prefetch by prefix
 await client.prefetch({ keyPrefix: 'session/42', tracekey: 'acct-7/promo' });
 // on hit (server): metrics.increment('kv_prefetch_hits')
 ```

 lena: ```py
 # Python prefetch example: key-prefix + tracekey grouping
 client.prefetch(key_prefix='org-x/ctx', tracekey='org-x/promo')
 # on hit: metrics.increment('kv_prefetch_hits')
 ```

 tom: nit: SDKs normalize `tracekey` (one word) so that's good. can we also include the migration troubleshooting snippet: "If you see zeros in the dashboard, confirm alias mapping kv_prefetch_hits -> kv_prefetch_hit_total" ? That helped a customer last month.

 lena: added the troubleshooting line to the FAQ.

 docs-bot: CI: docs build failed for PR #1310  external console link flagged by linkcheck plugin. Add an allowlist comment or mark external link intentional.

 ops-bot: FYI platform change required: alias mapping update scheduled for deploy window 02:00 UTC. Will post redirect when live.

 lena: action items: 1) ops to push alias mapping + redirect 2) tom to confirm runtime emits mapping in next rollout 3) izzy to sanity-check sampling blurb 4) lena to squash and request final review. I'll ping when CI is green. Thanks! :pray:
